label: DSS2 color · 24° LMC field

survey.title: DSS colored
survey.description: CDS color composition of DSS2 red and blue scanned photographic plates; green is the mean of the red and blue components.
survey.credit: Digitized Sky Survey - STScI/NASA, Colored & Healpixed by CDS
survey.acknowledgement: The Digitized Sky Surveys were produced at the Space Telescope Science Institute under U.S. Government grant NAG W-2166. The images are based on photographic data from the Oschin Schmidt Telescope and UK Schmidt Telescope; CDS produced the color HiPS composition.

passbands.red: POSS-II F, AAO-SES, SR and SERC-ER plates

centerSource.description: ICRF direction computed from properties.volume.originM; RA 78.76°, Dec -69.19°.

wcs.rasterOrientation: The JPEG is top-left raster order; it matches the FITS RGB planes after reversing FITS axis 2 (Y). Use the FITS-convention referencePixel and positive Y scale with the overlay pipeline's existing raster-to-FITS Y reversal.

wcsSource.description: Native WCS written by the CDS HiPS2FITS service for the same survey, dimensions, center, field, and projection as the JPEG.

verification.orientationCheck: A 300x300 nearest-neighbor sample of JPEG versus FITS showed same-channel correlations 0.894, 0.903, 0.915 only after FITS Y reversal; mean absolute differences were 2.25, 2.14, 2.34 DN.
verification.coverageAssessment: No alpha holes or fully blank rows/columns. The rendered field has conspicuous photographic plate seams, vignetting, and color/brightness discontinuities; use it as a wide scientific alignment comparison, not as the detail image or a seamless photometric mosaic.
verification.publisherCaveat: The CDS record states that three missing red plates use STScI DSSColor JPEG pixels and eleven missing blue plates, mainly in the Galactic plane, are red-only. The requested LMC cutout itself has no alpha holes.

recommendation: Add the JPEG as an Alignment-only wide comparison. Retain SMASH as the central higher-resolution detail layer; do not use this plate composite as a cloud reconstruction source without explicit seam/background correction.
